# DSH Agent Team Planner
中文 | English
**A project-planning workbench for DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams.**
DSH Agent Teams gives you the team and the task board. DSH Agent Team Planner adds the layer above i
t: **requirements, versions, stage gates, meetings, documents, confirmations and scheduling** — so a
group of agents behaves like a small delivery team instead of a chat room.
> One workspace = one project team. One version = one delivery pipeline. One click = the next legal
workspace = one project team. One version = one delivery pipeline. One click = the next legal move.
## Why this exists
Agent Teams is excellent at **coordination primitives**: spawn a teammate, assign a task, wait, comp
lete. It intentionally does not decide *what* should be built, *when* a phase is allowed to start, o
r *which document* is the source of truth.
This plugin supplies those decisions as a visible, auditable workflow:
| Without the planner | With the planner |

| Tasks appear from a conversation | Requirements enter a version, then a gate opens |
| "Is archite

cture done?" lives in chat | Architecture doc is an artifact; confirmation advances the stage |
| Me

mbers are ad-hoc names | Reusable roles, per-member model routes, display names |
| Meeting notes ar

e pasted somewhere | Meeting output becomes version-linked documents |
| Off-peak work needs manual
timing | High-efficiency mode schedules member work in idle windows |
It is a **community plugin**. It uses public Host services and the official Agent Teams API; it does
not fork, patch or bypass DSH.
## Feature tour
### 1. A single workbench, not another chat tab
The left-rail entry `dsh-agent-team-planner` opens a full main-area workbench with three tabs:
- **Version Board** — version header, five-stage pipeline, active tasks, timeline, team load, artifa

cts and manual confirmations.
- **Requirements** — a dedicated requirement workspace: create, edit,

attach files, assign members, bind to versions.
- **Meetings** — version-scoped requirement clarific
ation, architecture review, test review and custom meetings.
The top bar keeps project context together: current project, workspace switcher, current version, ve
rsion switcher, workspace folder opener, language toggle, Settings and Back to conversation.
The layout is dense by design: 60/40 main/side columns, internal scrolling, adaptive page sizes, no
e by design: 60/40 main/side columns, internal scrolling, adaptive page sizes, no page-level scroll.
### 2. Requirements with real attachments

- Create requirements with title, description and **multi-select members**.
- The team lead always p

articipates; selected members become the first-choice assignees.
- Upload multiple attachments: `txt

/ doc / docx / xls / xlsx / png / jpg / jpeg`, up to 10 MB each.
- Files are stored under the works
pace state directory and appear inside the requirement dialog with **open** and **remove** actions.
- Requirement documents are artifacts, not hidden prompts.
### 3. Versions, gates and task dispatch
A version moves through:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- Requirement stage: requirement docs must be confirmed before entering architecture.
- Architecture

stage: an architecture document must be confirmed before development.
- Development: task specs are

generated/edited, then dispatched as official Agent Teams tasks.
- Review/testing: completion creat

es review/test tasks; confirmed reports advance the version.
- Completed/archived versions are **rea
d-only**: requirements, artifacts, captures and meetings cannot be edited.
Task specs can be produced by a local deterministic splitter (selected developers first, then archit
ecture document / requirement text) or edited manually as JSON. The splitter never blocks on an agen
t turn, so it works even while the lead is busy.
### 4. Members: configured first, activated on first use
- Six default profiles are available for new projects: Luna (Product), Kael (Architect), Zoe (Fronte

nd), Owen (Backend), Mia (Test), Jasper (Ops).
- `member.create` is **configuration-only**. It does

not spawn an official teammate, start a conversation, or run a task.
- The official teammate is crea
ted lazily on first dispatch or first meeting participation; an existing official teammate with the

same name is adopted instead of duplicated.
- Per-member model route: provider / model / reasoning e

ffort.
- Blocked members stop receiving dispatch; removed members stay in the official roster but le

ave the project roster.
- Roles display by **display name** everywhere in the UI.

## Requirements
- **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2** or a compatible 0.2.x release, with the official **Agent Teams** p

rofile enabled.
- **Node.js 20+**.
- Windows, macOS or Linux. The manual installer is PowerShell; th
e plugin itself is Node.js.
## Security and privacy

- No telemetry, analytics or external service calls from the planner.
- All planning data and attach

ments stay in the workspace under `.dsh_teams/planner/`.
- No credentials are stored by the plugin;

model routes reference provider/model identifiers only.
- Agent execution remains owned by DSH and t
he official Agent Teams runtime.
## Known limitations

- Built and tested against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; newer DSH releases may change Host/client seams.
- GitH

ub-only distribution; no npm package.
- Chinese holiday calendar currently covers 2026; future years

need an annual update.
- Token usage is not exposed by the official task view; task details state t

his explicitly instead of inventing numbers.
- Custom in-conversation confirmation requests are not
yet extracted automatically; the manual-confirmation section derives from development completion and
utomatically; the manual-confirmation section derives from development completion and draft reports.
